audit: T-P1.8A read-only VirtIO block driver audit
verdict: No driver correctness blocker found in the bounded, fixed ARM QEMU virt contract. Runner macro mismatch independently reproduced and reported; parent assigned its fix.

findings.description: Host runner passed -DSTYLEOS_VBLK_MODEL=1 while the driver/header expose the model only under STYLEOS_VBLK_HOST_TEST. Original invocation fails under -Werror with incomplete vb_model_bus and implicit model functions. Correct define passes.
findings.status: Reported to parent; runner owner fixing concurrently; runner input is mutable and final hash may differ.

limits: No QEMU was run by this auditor, per parent instruction. These are host/model results and source analysis, not hardware/DMA or persistence evidence.
Host adapter intentionally bypasses ARM physical placement and cache/MMU admission.
Existing ring wrap test exercises modulo-8 ring slots; 16-bit index wrap is unreachable within the 8192-request cap. Extended harness exercises 1024 full ring rotations.

Generic caller buffers are never passed to DMA. They are copied via the admitted bounce page and must fit completely in the fixed reserved Image; this is not an arbitrary pointer-to-physical contract.
Runtime admission follows inherited loader-cleared BSS startup. Binary proof must bind the complete Image/BSS load and clear extents.
